name: Complete 4-Stage Torso-to-Head Blank-State 3D Generative FDM Neck & Head Architecture
user_statement: yeah looks good lets lock that in. please upload, commit & cleanup everything. perform a review and then also mark that task as done.
scope: Selected 4-stage 3D-printable FDM neck & head connector architecture (Stage 1 Neck Root Cradle, Stage 2 Yaw-to-Pitch L-Link, Stage 3 Pitch-to-Head Right-Side U-Cradle, Stage 4 Consolidated Head Sensor/Compute/Mic Carrier) with 34 pressed-in 304 SS compression sleeves (6+8+6+14), asymmetric 3D edge bevels (r_inner > r_outer), 0.0000 mm^3 overlap across all 29 yaw x pitch poses and 4 exterior shells, and matched 3D tetrahedral Gmsh FEM across PAHT-CF dry/wet and PETG-CF. Replaces 14 legacy sheet-metal/PA12 parts and v21 ribbon-clamp hardware. Physical print tolerances, press-fit sleeve retention, bolt preload relaxation, MIPI ribbon flex fatigue, and learned-control qualification remain separate.

stage_selection.stage1_neck_root_cradle: Family 2 Blank-State 3D SIMP Arch with 6 pressed-in 304 SS sleeves (2x M3 torso spine + 4x M2 rear XM335 case + left cheek wrap, 3.37 g total, stall p99=28.59 MPa, u_max=0.4211 mm, 3.22x dry PAHT-CF SF)
stage_selection.stage2_neck_yaw_to_pitch_link: Family 1 Ribbed Box-Cradle L-Link with 8 pressed-in 304 SS sleeves (4x M2 yaw horn + 4x M2 pitch horn, R=9.4 mm tangent circular upper dome, Z>=374.5 mm stepped deck, and deep triangulated corner gussets, 7.34 g total, stall p99=39.38 MPa, u_max=2.2875 mm, 2.34x dry PAHT-CF SF)
stage_selection.stage3_neck_pitch_to_head_cradle: Family 2 Blank-State 3D SIMP Right-Side U-Cradle with 6 pressed-in 304 SS sleeves (4x M2 pitch case rear + 2x M3 head carrier tongue, 7.68 g total, stall p99=22.20 MPa, u_max=1.1812 mm, 4.14x dry PAHT-CF SF)
stage_selection.stage4_head_sensor_compute_carrier: Family 1 Consolidated One-Piece Ribbed Sensor/Compute/Mic Carrier with 14 pressed-in 304 SS sleeves (2x M3 neck root + 4x M2.5 ROCK4D + 8x M2 stereo/wide cameras + integrated right mic wing + dorsal stiffening ribs in Y in [-11.40, -10.15], 10.18 g total, stall p99=17.89 MPa, u_max=2.6133 mm, 5.14x dry PAHT-CF SF)

qualification_limits: Selected FDM neck & head connector CAD and linear P1 tetrahedral FEM verification (1g upright, 3g dynamic nod/turn, 6g fall recovery, and 1.60 N*m dual-axis XM335 stall across PAHT-CF dry/wet and PETG-CF with 34 bonded 304 SS compression sleeves). Physical print tolerances, press-fit sleeve retention, bolt preload relaxation, MIPI ribbon flex fatigue, and learned-control transfer remain unqualified.
